usedFor: Gallabox holds contacts, Google Drive holds files, and “New Contact” can start “Create a new sheet or doc or slide”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Contact” in Gallabox, then “Share File With Anyone” in Google Drive
bestTemplate.why: It makes a file reachable by link and sets Viewer, Commenter or Editor access for each new contact.

watchOut: “Delete File” in Google Drive deletes permanently, and “Contact Updated” in Gallabox can fire repeatedly, so take care pairing them.
